repository.name: @webex/common
repository.purpose: Zero-Webex-dependency shared helpers that more than one Webex JS SDK plugin needs. Sits at the bottom of the workspace dependency graph: src/ imports no @webex/* package at runtime.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/common package barrel
public_interfaces.audience: 33 workspace packages across 104 import sites, plus external npm consumers
public_interfaces.notes: 39 named exports. README.md documents 6 as the externally supported subset; the rest is internal-consumer surface.

public_interfaces.name: package scripts
public_interfaces.notes: Do not run the aggregate `test` script: it chains undefined test:integration and test:browser.

refresh_with: update alongside the behavior change in the same commit

recommended: review the 104 consumer import sites before removing or renaming an export
confirm the encoding is unchanged; both formats are unversioned and persisted by consumers

change_impact.notes: The barrel is the public surface. Adding is safe; removing or renaming is broadly breaking.

affects: every consumer that persists or compares Hydra ids
change_impact.notes: Encoding is unversioned and has no test coverage. Pin behavior with a characterization test first.

evidence_rules.requirement: The script must exist in package.json scripts. test:integration and test:browser are referenced but undefined.
evidence_rules.notes: Never cite the aggregate `test` script as runnable.

evidence_rules.requirement: A symbol is public only if re-exported from the barrel.
evidence_rules.notes: Consumers import from the package root; there are no subpath entry points.

evidence_rules.requirement: Ground every behavioral claim in source or test evidence.
evidence_rules.notes: Commit history was ruled out as an evidence source during onboarding; unsupported rationale is marked [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT].

negative_guidance.rule: Do not import any @webex/* package from src/ at runtime.
negative_guidance.why: This package is the bottom of the dependency graph; an import creates a cycle for its 33 consumers. No automated check enforces it.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat Exception as having a static extend().
negative_guidance.why: README.md documents Exception.extend(), which does not exist and has zero call sites. Subclass with `class X extends Exception {}`.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not change the ciscospark:// Hydra encoding or the OAuth state encoding.
negative_guidance.why: Both are unversioned and persisted by consumers, so a change invalidates existing values.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not rely on `deprecated` at runtime in production.
negative_guidance.why: src/deprecated.js substitutes an empty decorator when NODE_ENV is production.
src/tap.js swallows callback errors by design and always resolves with the original value.

high.expectation: Source and test evidence both support the change, and the affected export surface is covered by a unit spec.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence exists. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying; omit rationale that evidence cannot support.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question. Stop and report the gap; 17 of 25 source files have no dedicated unit spec.

main_entrypoints.name: package barrel
main_entrypoints.purpose: Single public entry point re-exporting 39 symbols

workspace_packages.name: @webex/common
workspace_packages.notes: One module; this SDD root is the package directory inside the webex-js-sdk monorepo.

source_surfaces.name: implementation
source_surfaces.notes: Flat set of single-purpose files plus src/in-browser/.

source_surfaces.name: unit tests
source_surfaces.notes: 8 spec files covering 8 of 25 source files.

generated_surfaces.name: build output
generated_surfaces.notes: JavaScript and source maps only; no .d.ts is emitted.

generated_surfaces.name: repo-standards template snapshot
generated_surfaces.notes: Bundled, checksum-verified snapshot. Upstream-owned; do not hand-edit.

sync_paths.notes: Network-free copy from the bundled plugin snapshot.

rules: Orient the reader before describing detail.
Link to the module specification rather than duplicating it.
folder_readme_contract.example_policy: Examples are allowed only when verified against src/ or test/unit/spec/.
folder_readme_contract.fallback: Omit a section rather than inventing content; mark unresolved facts [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT].

fallback_rules: When source and tests disagree, code is the referee and the disagreement is recorded rather than silently resolved.
When neither source nor tests settle a question, mark it [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] instead of inferring.
Commit history is not a valid rationale source for this package.
